The Science Behind Real Results

Most skincare marketing asks you to believe the promise on the front of the bottle. Dr. Lurie asks a different question: can the active ingredient stay stable, reach the right place, and work long enough to matter?

  • Delivery: helping useful ingredients get where they need to go
  • Stability: protecting ingredients so they can remain effective
  • Duration: supporting results over time, not just for a few minutes
  • Body fit: designing around how skin and physiology actually behave

That is the practical difference between chasing claims and understanding the mechanism.
